name: harness-status-names-which-session-holds-what
description: R15, DISTINGUISH HALF, over a UUID-SHAPED identity. Session A takes SHARED on docs/plan.md and peer session B takes EXCLUSIVE on docs/spec.md; GET /status then reports one row per agent, and the content of this fixture is WHICH agent holds WHICH artifact. `sessions[].agent_id` is the hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 form (`str(session_to_agent_id(...))`), so it is hit by BOTH default scrubs -- the `_UUID_KEYS` name rule and the string-position `_UUID_RE` -- and without `preserve_identity` both rows collapse to `<UUID>`, leaving a body that reads as an attribution and cannot tell A-holds-plan from the swap. That is the difference from fixture 02, whose writer field is 32-char hex that the 8-4-4-4-12 regex never matched: 02 would pass identically with the opt-in deleted, so the opt-in was shipped unexercised. This fixture is what observes it, and `test_status_identity_fixture_distinguishes_which_session_holds_what` is where the swap is pinned. `agent_name` is null on purpose and is not noise: R6 moved the name behind the operator tier because it renders the raw session id, so the non-reversible `agent_id` is the only identity this tier carries -- which is exactly why it has to be compared verbatim. policy_summary carries the absolute workspace root and coordinator_version tracks the package version, so both are ignored for the same reasons fixture warn_mode/08 ignores them.
_comment: The two agent ids are uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'ccs-agent:claude-session-<session id>') over the two session ids this fixture supplies, so they are derived rather than observed and the same two values are recomputed in test_effect_fence_corpus.py rather than pasted. Row ORDER is the adapter's _agent_names insertion order, i.e. the preflight order: A registers on pre-read, B on pre-edit. tracked_artifacts[].id IS scrubbed -- an artifact id is minted per run and is not an identity this fixture asserts -- which doubles as the in-body control that the opt-in is scoped to the declared key and did not disable the default wholesale. python-only for the same reason fixture warn_mode/08 is: the Node /status envelope is a different shape (see warn_mode/09). caller_principal_absent_total is 2 because both preflights are sent without a caller principal and name sessions nobody claimed: pre-read (accept-class) and pre-edit (require-class, which admits an unclaimed session -- KTD15) are each admitted and counted (plan U6), and nothing else in the fixture moves it. Nothing is refused, so caller_principal_refused_total is 0.
